mainEntity.name: Should I use Zoom, a webinar platform, or an AI presentation tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose regular meeting software when the event is small and interaction matters most; choose a dedicated webinar platform when registration, branding, audience controls, analytics, and replay management are central. The right choice depends on the event’s scale and operating needs, not the word “webinar” alone. Context: Community discussions compare general tools with dedicated platforms and frequently emphasize Q&A, polls, chat, registration timing, and audience size. Key factors: - Expected attendance and interaction - Registration and reminder requirements - Recording, replay, and analytics - Presenter and moderator controls Practical guidance: List the must-have features before comparing vendors. Run a private test with the actual camera, microphone, slides, polls, captions, and handoffs. Keep a backup presentation file and communication method ready in case the platform fails.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use meeting software for a smaller interactive session and consider dedicated webinar software when registration, audience controls, analytics, branding, and replay handling matter. AI presentation tools assist with content and visuals; they do not replace the platform. Compare required features, attendee count, interaction, recording, and technical support.
